name: cni-ss-qt1
label: CNI Slice-Shuffled qT1 Mapping
description: T1 fitting tool for data acquired with the slice-shuffled SMS IR-EPI sequence from CNI.

nifti.description: NIFTI file from the qT1 scan

nifti_rpe.description: NIFTI file from the reverse phase encoding qT1 scan

nifti_B0map_magnitude.description: NIFTI file of the magnitude image from the B0 map scan (2D Fast GRE)

nifti_B0map_frequency.description: NIFTI file of the frequency image from the B0 map scan (2D Fast GRE)

TI.description: Shortest TI of the slice-shuffled scan (second). Use the config value if cannot be derived from the nifti metadata

TR.description: TR of the slice-shuffled scan (second). Use the config value if cannot be derived from the nifti metadata

calibration_cycle.description: Number of calibration cycles at the beginning of data acquisition. Use the config value if cannot be derived from the nifti metadata

calibration_volume.description: Number of calibration volumes at the beginning of the NIFTI file. Use the config value if cannot be derived from the nifti metadata

unwarp_direction.description: Direction of the EPI distortion correction. The definition is as follows: phase encoding (PE) direction = A/P, PE polarity = 0 (pe0), then unwarp_direction = y; PE direction = A/P, PE polarity = 1 (pe1), then unwarp_direction = y- (default); PE direction = R/L, PE polarity = 0, then unwarp_direction = x; PE direction = R/L, PE polarity = 1, then unwarp_direction = x-

unwarp_t1map.description: Flag for applying B0map correction to the T1map. Default is false (B0map correction is applied to the unshuffled images). Use this only when there are missing volumes in the acquisition.

descending_slices.description: Descending or ascending slice acquisition. Use the config value if cannot be derived from the nifti metadata

esp.description: Effective echo spacing (second). Use the config value if cannot be derived from the nifti metadata

mask_threshold.description: Fractional intensity threshold (0->1); smaller values give larger brain outline estimates

multiband_factor.description: Multiband factor of the slice-shuffled scan

topup_method.description: Algorithm used for applytopup. 'jac' for Jacobian, 'lsr' for least-square resampling

author: Hua Wu
